title: Yellowed Crispy Argentinian Oats Empanadas
description: A low-carb friendly Argentinian dish featuring porridge oats and a briny glassy-jelly filling, deep-fried to a crispy golden brown. This show-off empanada is perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together oats, eggs, salt, and pepper to form a thick dough.
Gradually add olive oil to the dough and mix until a ball forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle.
In a pan, heat a couple of tablespoons of oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the beef broth to the pan and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Place a tablespoon of the onion and garlic mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Deep-fry the empanadas in hot oil until golden brown and crispy.
